sentences.text: Wenupteryx was a pterosaur of small size.
The genus Wenupteryx was first named by Laura Codorniú and Zulma Gasparini in 2013.
The type species of the genus Wenupteryx is Wenupteryx uzi.
Wenupteryx is classified as a small-sized pterodactyloid pterosaur related to the clades Euctenochasmatia or Archaeopterodactyloidea.
Fossils of Wenupteryx are known from the Late Jurassic (Tithonian stage) Vaca Muerta formation in Neuquén Province, southern Argentina.
Wenupteryx lived during the Tithonian stage, between 149.2 and 143.1 million years ago.
